fan-target.name: Fan Target
fan-target.description: Sets the fan controller's target temperature below the default 91C, with the automatic fan control left on. Runs in the background and restores the target if a game changes it. Use one variant only: lower targets make the fan react earlier and run faster; 85C is a good start.

ps5-dump-forge-desktop.name: PS5 Dump Forge (desktop)
ps5-dump-forge-desktop.description: Desktop app and command-line tool of PS5 Dump Forge: convert and edit PS5 game dumps and images on a computer, transfer games to and from a console running Forge, and install Forge on a PS5 in one click. Nothing to install: unzip and run. Windows 10/11, macOS 11 or later, Linux with glibc 2.35 or later.

payloads.name: LegacyJB
payloads.description: Jailbreak service (TCP 9028) for supported apps such as Homebrew Store and Itemzflow.

payloads.name: PS5 Account Tools
payloads.description: Local account manager with a web interface on port 6769. Offline activation, fake PSN sign-in for features like Remote Play, and avatar changes.

payloads.name: APR Emu Updater
payloads.description: Choose which APR Emu (libSceAmpr.sprx) build each installed game uses, from a web interface on port 6971. Needs NanoDNS on first run and ShadowMountPlus for image-installed games.

payloads.name: PS5SX2 Helper
payloads.description: Helper for PS5SX2, a PCSX2 port for PS5. It jailbreaks the emulator, mounts /data into it, and shows PS2 discs as tiles on the home screen. After every restart load ShadowMountPlus first, then this helper. Load only one helper.

payloads.name: PS5SX2 Installer
payloads.description: Installs or updates PS5SX2, a PCSX2 port for PS5, from GitHub and launches it. Needs your own PS2 BIOS in /data/PCSX2/bios and games in /data/PCSX2/games. Requires: PS5SX2 Helper.

payloads.name: PS5 Upload Helper
payloads.description: Console-side helper for the PS5 Upload app on PC, Mac, Android or web. Resumable uploads, package installs, file and game management on port 9120. Enter the 6-digit code it shows in the app to pair. Keep the app and helper on the same version.

payloads.name: ShadowMountPlus
payloads.description: Background auto-mounter that detects, mounts and installs game dumps and images from internal or external storage (UFS, exFAT, PFS). Needs kstuff-lite 1.07 or newer; load at every boot. Settings in /data/shadowmount/config.ini.

payloads.name: PS4Mount
payloads.description: Plays PS4 fake PKGs straight from an exFAT USB drive without installing them. Put the game and update .pkg files in the drive root; it adds them to the home screen. Web panel on port 8770 and in the Media tab. Needs fake PKG support (e.g. etaHEN with kstuff) and kernel log access (klogsrv on port 3232, or no other payload reading /dev/klog). Load after every boot. Tested on firmware 13.20.

payloads.name: Remote Play PIN
payloads.description: Shows the Remote Play pairing PIN and account id for the logged-in user on an offline activated account, so chiaki, chiaki-ng or the official Remote Play app can pair. Activate the account first (e.g. with PS5 Account Tools or offact), reboot if pairing fails, then load this. Load it again to cancel pairing.

payloads.name: Fan Target 85C
payloads.description: Sets the fan controller's target temperature to 85C instead of the default 91C, with the automatic fan control left on. Runs in the background and restores the target if a game changes it. Use one version only: installing another temperature replaces this one.

payloads.name: Fan Target 80C
payloads.description: Sets the fan controller's target temperature to 80C instead of the default 91C, with the automatic fan control left on. Runs in the background and restores the target if a game changes it. Use one version only: installing another temperature replaces this one.

payloads.name: Fan Target 75C
payloads.description: Sets the fan controller's target temperature to 75C instead of the default 91C, with the automatic fan control left on. Runs in the background and restores the target if a game changes it. Use one version only: installing another temperature replaces this one.

payloads.name: Fan Target 70C
payloads.description: Sets the fan controller's target temperature to 70C instead of the default 91C, with the automatic fan control left on. Runs in the background and restores the target if a game changes it. Use one version only: installing another temperature replaces this one.

payloads.name: Fan Target 65C
payloads.description: Sets the fan controller's target temperature to 65C instead of the default 91C, with the automatic fan control left on. Runs in the background and restores the target if a game changes it. Use one version only: installing another temperature replaces this one.

payloads.name: PS5X360 Helper
payloads.description: Autoload helper for PS5X360, an Xbox 360 emulator for PS5 based on Xenia Canary. It keeps the PS5X360 app up to date from its GitHub releases. Install the app first (PS5X360 download).

payloads.name: NeoEnabler
payloads.description: Starts PS4 games without PS4 Pro support in Pro mode, so game patches can raise them to higher resolutions, up to native 4K; only useful for games that have a NeoEnabler patch. Load ps-patch-system first, then this, after every boot. Pick patches in the panel on port 8765 or in the Media tab.

payloads.name: LZ4 Compression Engine
payloads.description: Engine of LZ4 Compression, which shrinks installed PS5 games on the console with LZ4 asset packs and .ffpfsc compression. Serves the LZ4 Compression app and a web page on port 5920. If the app doesn't start it by itself, load it here first, then open the app.

payloads.name: Game Updater Engine
payloads.description: Engine of Game Updater, which finds and installs the newest official update for installed PS5 games, with a backport when an update needs newer firmware. Serves the Game Updater app and a web page on port 7920. If the app doesn't start it by itself, load it here first, then open the app.

payloads.name: PS5 Dump Forge
payloads.description: Converts and edits PS5 game dumps and images on the console: game folders, exfat, ffpkg, ffpfs, ffpfsc and FPKG, also straight from zip, 7z and rar, with transfers to other Forge instances and NAS shares (SMB, FTP, NFS). Open http://<PS5 IP>:8095 in any browser.

payloads.name: Orbit Store (Beta)
payloads.description: A modern PS5 download manager with a native TV app, resumable downloads and phone controls.

inactive.name: Spectrum Library
inactive.description: Native content manager for browsing and downloading supported game files.

downloads.name: PS5X360
downloads.description: Xbox 360 emulator app for PS5, based on Xenia Canary. Not a payload: extract the zip and copy the whole PPSA50011 folder to /data/homebrew/ over FTP, then let ShadowMountPlus register it. Needs etaHEN, kstuff and ShadowMountPlus, plus your own Xbox 360 games.

downloads.name: AMPR Emu
downloads.description: APR Emu (AMPR userland emulation) library, libSceAmpr.sprx, which some games need. Not a payload: ShadowMountPlus downloads the latest build by itself, and APR Emu Updater picks a build per game. Download it only to install it by hand.

downloads.name: PlayGo Stub
downloads.description: Lightweight replacement for a game's PlayGo runtime library, libScePlayGo.sprx. It reports all content chunks and languages as installed, so titles that wait on PlayGo can carry on. Not a payload: it replaces the game's own module. Optional settings in playgo_stub.dat in the game folder (/app0).

downloads.name: DLC Emu
downloads.description: Replacement modules (libSceAppContent, libSceNpEntitlementAccess, libSceGameUpdate) that make a game see the DLC listed in dlc_emu.ini in its folder (/app0) as owned. Not a payload: the zip has normal and logging builds of the modules, an example dlc_emu.ini and a helper script.

downloads.name: PS5-ECAM
downloads.description: Wii U, 3DS, DS and Switch emulation (Cemu, Azahar, melonDS and Eden) in one launcher for the TV and the DualSense. Not a payload: extract the zip, copy the PPSA99360 folder to /data/homebrew/, and let your HEN jailbreak the title (etaHEN app list, OnionHEN exact_title_ids, or an ELF loader on port 9021). Updates itself from then on.

downloads.name: PS5LM
downloads.description: Runs GGUF language models with llama.cpp on the console's GPU and serves them to your network on port 8081, with OpenAI and Anthropic compatible APIs, a browser chat page and a TV screen. Not a payload: extract the zip and copy the PPSA99575 folder to /data/homebrew/ over FTP. Needs kstuff-lite, etaHEN and ShadowMountPlus; firmware 7.00 to 13.60.

downloads.name: LZ4 Compression
downloads.description: The LZ4 Compression app (PPSA99420), which shrinks installed games on the console. Extract the zip and copy the PPSA99420 folder to /data/homebrew/ over FTP; ShadowMountPlus adds the tile. Needs the LZ4 Compression Engine payload. Updates itself, engine included.

downloads.name: Game Updater
downloads.description: The Game Updater app (PPSA99440): update installed PS5 games in a few taps, on the console. Extract the zip and copy the PPSA99440 folder to /data/homebrew/ over FTP. Needs the Game Updater Engine payload.

downloads.name: Pegasus DL+
downloads.description: Native app (formerly the Pegasus DL payload): browse catalogs, queue downloads, extract archives and install packages on the PS5 with the controller. Copy PPSA99998.ffpfsc into your loader's homebrew folder (ShadowMountPlus mounts it), refresh and launch Pegasus DL+. Updates itself; sends app launch and reliability diagnostics.

downloads.name: PS5 Dump Forge for Windows x86-64
PS5 Dump Forge for Windows x86-64 (bundled WebView2)
PS5 Dump Forge for Windows arm64
PS5 Dump Forge for Linux x86-64
PS5 Dump Forge for Linux arm64

links.name: PS5PKGTool
links.description: A Windows app for managing your PS5 dump and image collection, reading PS5 packages, and building or converting images.

links.name: ps5-commander
links.description: A dual-pane file manager for the PS5 with full gamepad support. It supports internal and external storage devices, secure file copying, archives, game images, a built-in text editor, and the ability to manually mount games from folders.
